purpose: Discovery longlist and initial detailed screening for Constitutive Atlas; no ingestion or public release authorized by this ledger alone.
counting_note: Ten GEOLAB material workbooks are counted separately within one corpus. LEAP campaigns are related, may reuse tests, and are not independent validation populations.
admission_checks: Applicable dataset redistribution terms and exact version/file hashes
Real measurement histories, not only fitted parameters/summary strengths/simulations
Initial effective stress, void ratio/OCR and preparation/loading metadata
Stress/strain units, signs, total/effective conventions and time/cycle ordering
Original versus digitized observations and specimen localization limits
Protocol supported by engine and UI; data admission separate from model capability
Deduplicate original experiments across compilations; hold out whole tests/campaigns for validation

ranking_rationale: Prefer explicit reuse terms, measured channels with documented units and initial state, material/protocol diversity, and compatibility with existing element drivers. Ranking is provisional until per-test checks; no numerical quality score is inferred from repository reputation.
review_limits: All 30 candidate entries have an explicit ingestion or hold decision. Twenty-one candidates have admitted records; nine remain held or paused.
Counts distinguish SI triaxial overlays, native measurement series and test summaries. Acquisition blocks and grain populations are not independent laboratory tests.
GEOLAB basic-property and reference tables are retained as context. Empty templates, parameter/model tabs and source duplicates in LEAP calibration-example folders are excluded.

Raw tomography volumes, CAD/printing assets, machine configuration files and redundant workbook exports are outside this material-response ingestion pass. Processed 3DXRD grain data and original mechanical acquisition files are included.
A source licence declaration is retained as evidence, not represented as a new licence grant from Atlas.
The prior 4TU compilation remains paused at user request.
